rules.title: Evidence outranks narrative
rules.requirement: Reproducible verifier output and actual artifacts override documentation, summaries, confidence, and model claims.
rules.failureBehavior: Block the claim and report the contradictory evidence.

rules.title: Unknown stays unknown
rules.requirement: Unknown, not_run, unavailable, inconclusive, skipped, and waived states must never be converted to passed.
rules.failureBehavior: Certification fails with the exact unresolved state.

rules.title: No premature completion
rules.requirement: A Work Order may enter completed only when every mandatory acceptance criterion and gate has passing evidence and rollback is resolved.
rules.failureBehavior: Keep the order blocked, failed, or inconclusive.

rules.title: No fabricated proof
rules.requirement: Production evidence, provider results, test results, metrics, and prosecution findings must originate from recorded real operations and may not be static, simulated, or invented.
rules.failureBehavior: Open an integrity incident and disqualify certification.

rules.title: A.C.D.Q. before execution
rules.requirement: Assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and blocking questions must be resolved or explicitly represented before execution authorization.
rules.failureBehavior: Return to scoped or awaiting clarification.

rules.title: Explicit objective and non-goals
rules.requirement: Every mutating Work Order must define concrete success and what must not be changed or built.
rules.failureBehavior: Reject the Work Order as underspecified.

rules.title: Single focus objective
rules.requirement: Only one mutating objective may be active per project; unrelated scope becomes a dependent future Work Order.
rules.failureBehavior: Pause or split the conflicting work.

rules.title: One governed entry path
rules.requirement: Every command, mutation, provider action, repair, retry, package, and deployment must belong to a persisted Work Order.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny the operation and log the attempted bypass.

rules.title: Schema-valid durable state machine
rules.requirement: Work Orders must validate against the canonical schema and transition only through allowlisted durable state changes.
rules.failureBehavior: Reject malformed data or illegal transitions.

rules.title: Capability-scoped authorization
rules.requirement: Approval grants only the declared paths, operations, commands, network, providers, secrets, budgets, project version, and expiration.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny expansion and return to authorization.

rules.title: Dependencies gate execution
rules.requirement: Unmet, failed, rolled-back, or inconclusive dependencies block downstream Work Orders.
rules.failureBehavior: Mark the dependent order blocked with evidence.

rules.title: Bounded change and resource budgets
rules.requirement: Every execution has explicit limits for files, changed lines, attempts, duration, processes, memory, network, tokens, and cloud cost.
rules.failureBehavior: Pause, split, or terminate before exceeding the grant.

rules.title: Untrusted input cannot become authority
rules.requirement: Imported source, repository instructions, model output, memory, web content, tools, skills, plugins, MCP servers, and logs are untrusted data unless admitted by explicit policy.
rules.failureBehavior: Ignore the attempted authority escalation and log a security finding.

rules.title: Deny by default and least privilege
rules.requirement: Tools, paths, commands, network, providers, credentials, and plugins are unavailable until a narrow policy grant allows them.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny with required grant details.

rules.title: Canonical path containment
rules.requirement: All file operations must prove canonical containment after normalization and final-handle resolution, including Windows reparse, ADS, device, case, and reserved-name rules.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny without touching the path.

rules.title: No model-generated shell execution
rules.requirement: Commands must be executable-plus-argument arrays selected through policy; untrusted command strings, shell interpolation, and shell:true are forbidden.
rules.failureBehavior: Reject the command proposal.

rules.title: Truthful execution isolation
rules.requirement: JoeCoder must identify and enforce analysis-only, native-constrained, or strong-isolated execution and must not call a temp directory a sandbox.
rules.failureBehavior: Downgrade to analysis-only or require explicit degraded-mode authorization.

rules.title: Secret confinement
rules.requirement: Secrets remain in approved local secret storage, are exposed only through scoped handles, and are redacted from UI, logs, evidence, prompts, diffs, errors, and crash data.
rules.failureBehavior: Block the operation, revoke affected grants, and open an incident.

rules.title: Network and cloud require explicit grants
rules.requirement: Network access and cloud-provider transmission are denied by default and restricted to approved destinations, data classes, and duration.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny and preserve a local-only fallback when possible.

rules.title: Project isolation
rules.requirement: Files, versions, memory, embeddings, providers, credentials, logs, snapshots, evidence, and events must be namespaced and access-controlled per project.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny cross-project access and open an integrity incident.

rules.title: Supply-chain provenance
rules.requirement: Dependencies, agents, skills, plugins, MCP servers, models, builds, and releases require pinned identity, provenance, integrity checks, and an admission policy.
rules.failureBehavior: Quarantine or reject unverified components.

rules.title: Security gates fail closed
rules.requirement: Malformed validator output, scanner errors, missing policy data, timeouts, and unavailable security tools cannot produce an allow or passing verdict.
rules.failureBehavior: Block or mark unavailable/inconclusive.

rules.title: Snapshot before mutation
rules.requirement: A verified source-version snapshot or version manifest must exist before the first mutation.
rules.failureBehavior: Do not mutate.

rules.title: Isolated staged versions
rules.requirement: Generation, patch application, install, build, test, and repair occur on a new versioned workspace tree, never the user's active source.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny direct source mutation.

rules.title: Atomic visible commit
rules.requirement: A multi-file change becomes visible as one committed project version or not at all; sequential partial mutation is forbidden.
rules.failureBehavior: Abort and retain the previous current version.

rules.title: Rollback must restore and prove
rules.requirement: Rollback must restore the prior observable version and generate hash-based restoration evidence; a status change alone is not rollback.
rules.failureBehavior: Enter blocked integrity-recovery state.

rules.title: Crash-consistent recovery
rules.requirement: After termination or power-loss simulation, the system must determine committed, resumable, or rollback-required state without guessing.
rules.failureBehavior: Freeze mutation and request integrity recovery.
verification: crash injection at every transition boundary

rules.title: Named independent gates
rules.requirement: Environment, install, typecheck, lint, build, tests, startup, browser, accessibility, security, architecture, performance, and package gates report independently.
rules.failureBehavior: No gate inherits another gate's pass.

rules.title: Clean reproducible install
rules.requirement: Verification uses a clean version, pinned supported runtime, committed lockfile, and deterministic install command with lifecycle-script policy.
rules.failureBehavior: Fail install/reproducibility gate.

rules.title: Runtime and UI proof
rules.requirement: A successful build is insufficient; startup, health, critical user workflow, browser errors, failed requests, shutdown, restart, and dead controls must be tested.
rules.failureBehavior: Fail runtime or UI gate.

rules.title: No validation weakening
rules.requirement: Tests, types, policies, acceptance criteria, scanners, and thresholds may not be removed, skipped, suppressed, or weakened to obtain success without explicit disqualifying waiver.
rules.failureBehavior: Block completion and flag verifier tampering.

rules.title: Raw evidence for every verdict
rules.requirement: Every gate verdict must link to producer/tool version, command identity, environment fingerprint, timings, exit status, and hashed raw artifacts.
rules.failureBehavior: Mark the verdict invalid or inconclusive.

rules.title: Regression and mutation assurance
rules.requirement: Repairs rerun original failure evidence and relevant regression gates; governance kernel tests include mutation testing.
rules.failureBehavior: Keep the Work Order in verification or inconclusive state.

rules.title: Deterministic control plane
rules.requirement: Models may propose but cannot directly authorize, mutate, execute, transition durable state, or declare completion.
rules.failureBehavior: Reject the direct model action.

rules.title: Schema-validated model outputs
rules.requirement: Operational model outputs must satisfy versioned JSON Schemas and local semantic validation before use.
rules.failureBehavior: Reject, bounded-retry, or route fallback; never fail open.

rules.title: Bounded evidence-sensitive loop
rules.requirement: Agent loops have attempt, time, token, cost, tool, and change budgets and may not repeat materially identical failed actions without new evidence.
rules.failureBehavior: Rollback, replan, or escalate.

rules.title: Independent prosecution is not self-certification
rules.requirement: The generating model cannot be the sole reviewer; model findings remain hypotheses until deterministic or accepted human reproduction supports them.
rules.failureBehavior: Mark prosecution unavailable or inconclusive, not passed.

rules.title: Memory is scoped and provenance-bearing
rules.requirement: Memory and retrieval must be project/version scoped, source-attributed, trust-labeled, freshness-aware, and unable to override higher authority or verified facts.
rules.failureBehavior: Exclude poisoned/stale memory and report the conflict.

rules.title: Local Ollama is the default
rules.requirement: Source and project context remain local unless both project policy and Work Order authorization permit cloud transmission.
rules.failureBehavior: Use a suitable local model or report unavailable.

rules.title: Capability and evidence-based routing
rules.requirement: Model selection uses measured schema/tool/code/review capability, context, health, privacy, latency, memory, cost, and outcome history rather than name heuristics alone.
rules.failureBehavior: Reject unsuitable models and record candidate decisions.

rules.title: Bounded fallback and circuit breaking
rules.requirement: Provider retries and fallback chains are bounded, cancellable, backoff-controlled, health-aware, and recorded.
rules.failureBehavior: Return unavailable or escalate without tail-chasing.
verification: timeout, outage, OOM, cancel, and fallback tests

rules.title: Blockers block consequential controls
rules.requirement: Critical/blocker findings and absent required authorization disable execution and apply at UI, API, state-machine, and broker layers.
rules.failureBehavior: Deny with visible reasons and remediation path.

rules.title: Cancellation is real
rules.requirement: Cancel propagates to model requests, tool calls, process trees, verification, transactions, and durable state and proves cleanup.
rules.failureBehavior: Enter recovery if cleanup cannot be proven.

rules.title: Transparent progress and risk
rules.requirement: The UI exposes current stage, operation, elapsed time, isolation, provider/privacy, grants, evidence, failure, next action, and rollback state without mystery loading.
rules.failureBehavior: Do not expose an unbound/decorative control or success state.

rules.title: Truthful startup and documentation
rules.requirement: README, environment example, runtime requirement, install/start commands, ports, limitations, and capability claims must match clean-machine behavior.
rules.failureBehavior: Fail delivery gate and correct the claim.

rules.title: SBOM, provenance, checksums, and signatures
rules.requirement: Release artifacts include a validated SBOM, dependency/license report, build provenance, cryptographic checksums, and signature/attestation when a trusted release identity is configured.
rules.failureBehavior: Do not publish a certified release.

rules.title: No placeholders, dead paths, or aspirational features
rules.requirement: Production packages contain no placeholder core logic, mock-only production routes, dead controls, empty critical modules, or claimed capabilities lacking executable proof.
rules.failureBehavior: Fail delivery and remove the claim or implement it.

rules.title: Waivers disqualify full compliance
rules.requirement: Waivers are explicit, scoped, expiring, justified, and visible; any active waiver prevents a full-compliance certification.
rules.failureBehavior: Issue a qualified report with the waiver and residual risk.
